name: color
meaning: current text colour, stored as rgb | 0x05000000

name: texPage
meaning: texture page index of the font sheet; Text_DrawGlyph writes texPage + 4 as the RenderPoly type, the same +4 convention as Sprite.texPage

name: reserved
meaning: explicitly zeroed by Font_LoadFromRes and never read anywhere in the binary

name: cellW
meaning: width in TEXELS of one glyph cell on the sheet; the U span sampled per glyph (8 for the debug font, 16 for the game font)

name: cellH
meaning: height in TEXELS of one glyph cell (0x10 for both fonts); the V span and row stride

name: glyphWidth
meaning: advance width of one character in HUD units

name: glyphHeight
meaning: on-screen glyph height in HUD units (0xF for both fonts); used for the vertical clip test and the quad's bottom edge. Distinct from lineHeight (+0x12 = 0x11)

name: cellWShift
meaning: log2 of cellW (3 for the 8-wide debug font, 4 for the 16-wide game font). Written by Font_LoadFromRes; no reader was found - the glyph emitter multiplies by cellW instead

name: cellHShift
meaning: log2 of cellH (4 in both fonts). Written by Font_LoadFromRes, no reader found

name: cols
meaning: columns that fit in the current text window (windowW / glyphWidth); recomputed by Text_SetFont and Text_SetWindow

name: rows
meaning: rows that fit in the current text window (windowH / lineHeight)

name: sheetU
meaning: U origin of the font sheet's sub-rect within the 256-pixel texture page; glyph U = sheetU + col*cellW

name: sheetV
meaning: V origin of the font sheet; glyph V = sheetV + row*cellH

name: lineHeight
meaning: vertical advance per line; added to g_textCursorY on wrap and on '\n'

name: pad
meaning: tail padding of the 0x14-byte entry; never written or read
